Gemini.engine_rendering: Intelligent, sweet of speech, affectionate, correct in learned conduct; skilled in the sciences and the sastras, wealthy, generous in his dealings; adept, an astronomer, of middling build, having two mothers, fortunate, and modest.

Cancer.engine_rendering: Unsteady in his undertakings, famed for kingly qualities, yet hostile to his own party; of small fortune, handsome, afflicted by phlegm and bile, worn out by toil; fond of drink, even-handed in duty, proud, a knower of fine speech, of countries and of the directions; of long standing, and hostile to his father's people.

Leo.sanskrit: रिपुहन्ता क्रोधपरो विशिष्टचेष्टो वनाद्रिदुर्गचरः । उत्साही सत्त्वशूरस्तेजस्वी मांसभक्षणो रौद्रः ॥ गम्भीरः स्थिरसत्त्वो बधिरः क्षितिपालको धनसमृद्धः । सिंहस्थे दिवसकरे ख्यातः पुरुषो भवेज्जातः ॥
Leo.engine_rendering: A slayer of enemies, prone to anger, distinguished in action, roaming forests, hills and fastnesses; energetic, brave in spirit, lustrous, a meat-eater, terrible; grave, steady in courage, hard of hearing, a protector of land, abounding in wealth, and famous.

Capricorn.sanskrit: अटनप्रियोऽल्पसत्त्वः स्वपक्षविक्षोभनाशितसमस्तः । मकरस्थे दिवसकरे जातो बहुभक्षकः पुरुषः ॥ लुब्धः कुस्त्रीसक्तः कुकर्मसंवर्धितः सतृष्णः ॥
Capricorn.engine_rendering: Fond of wandering, of little force, everything of his destroyed by the disaffection of his own party, and a great eater; greedy, attached to bad women, grown up in evil deeds, and full of craving.

Aquarius.sanskrit: हृद्रोगी बहुसुतः सतां विगर्ह्योऽतिरोषश्च । परदाराणां सुभगः कर्मस्विति निश्चितो भवति ॥ दुःखप्रायोऽल्पधनः श्लथितसौहृदो मलिनमूर्तिः । कुम्भधरेऽर्के जातः पिशुनः स्यात् दुष्प्रापश्च ॥
Aquarius.engine_rendering: Suffering from heart disease, having many sons, censured by good men, and exceedingly wrathful; favoured by other men's wives, and decided in his undertakings; mostly sorrowful, of little wealth, his friendships slackened, of unclean appearance, a slanderer, and hard to reach.

Pisces.sanskrit: सुहृदां संग्रहशीलः स्त्रीप्रियो लब्धसौख्यसंभारः । राज्ञो बहुशुभदः क्षयोदयी भवति धनकीर्त्या ॥ सत्पुत्रभृत्याप्तयशा जलपण्यधनः सुवागनृतवादी । ऊर्जितगुह्यरुगार्तो बहुसहजो मीनसंस्थेऽर्के ॥

Aries.sanskrit: पद्माभैः पाणिपादैर्वित्तसुतजनो बकैलाकारनेत्रः । ससेदस्तोयभीस्त्रैणविकृतशिराः स्त्रीजितो मेष इन्दौ ॥
Aries.engine_rendering: With hands and feet of a lotus hue, having wealth and children; sweating readily, afraid of water, devoted to women, with an ill-shaped head, and ruled by women — thus the Moon in Aries.

Taurus.sanskrit: व्यूढोरस्कोऽतिदाता घनकुटिलकचः कामुकः कीर्तिशाली । कान्तः कन्याप्रजावान् वृषसमनयनो हंसलीलाप्रचारः । मध्यान्ते भोगभागी पृथुकटिचरणस्कन्धजान्वास्यजङ्घः । सांकः पार्श्वास्यपृष्ठे ककुदि शुभगतिः क्षान्तियुक्तो गवीन्दौ ॥
Taurus.engine_rendering: Broad-chested, a great giver, with thick curling hair, amorous, and full of renown; charming, having daughters, with eyes like a bull's, moving with the grace of a swan; enjoying his pleasures in the middle and the end of life; broad of hip, foot, shoulder, knee, face and shank; marked on the flank, face, back and shoulder-hump, of auspicious gait, and patient.

Gemini.sanskrit: उन्नासः श्यामचक्षुः सुरतविधिकलाकाव्यकृद्भोगभोगी । हस्ते मत्स्याधिपाङ्को विषयसुखरतो बुद्धिदक्षः स्थिरः । कान्तः सौभाग्यहास्यप्रियवचनयुतः स्त्रीजितो व्यायताङ्गो । याति नैशं सख्यं शशिनि मिथुनगे मातृयुग्मप्रपुष्टः ॥
Gemini.engine_rendering: High-nosed, dark-eyed, a maker of poetry and skilled in the arts of love, an enjoyer of pleasures; bearing the mark of a fish on the hand, given to the pleasures of sense, quick of intellect, steady; charming, endowed with good fortune, laughter and pleasing speech, ruled by women, long-limbed; he keeps his friendships by night, and is nourished by two mothers.

Cancer.sanskrit: युक्तः सौभाग्ययोगैर्गृहसुहृदनवद्यज्योतिषज्ञानधीरैः । कामासक्तः कृतज्ञः क्षितिपतिसचिवः सत्प्रमाणः प्रवासी । सोन्मादः केशकल्पो जनकुसुमरुचिर्ह्रीनिवृद्धानुयातः । प्रासादोद्यानवापीप्रियकरणरतः पीनकण्ठः कुलीरे ॥
Cancer.engine_rendering: Joined with combinations of good fortune — with home, friends, and a faultless steady knowledge of the star-science; attached to love, grateful, a minister to a ruler, of good measure, much travelled; somewhat frenzied, with fine hair, pleasing to look upon, modest, and followed by elders; delighting in the making of palaces, gardens and tanks, and thick of neck.

Leo.sanskrit: स्थूलशिरा मन्दरोमा पृथुवदनगलो ह्रस्वपिङ्गाक्षियुग्मः । स्त्रीद्वेषी क्षुत्पिपासाजठररदरुजा पीडितो मांसभक्षः । दाता तीक्ष्णोऽल्पपुत्रो विपिननगरतिर्मातृवश्यः सुवक्षाः । विक्रान्तः कालाप्तः … सत्त्ववेगगम्भीरदृष्टिः ॥
Leo.engine_rendering: With a large head and sparse body-hair, broad of face and neck, with a pair of short tawny eyes; hostile to women, afflicted by hunger, thirst, stomach- and tooth-ache, an eater of flesh; a giver, sharp, of few sons, fond of forest and city alike, obedient to his mother, broad-chested; valorous, and of a deep and forceful gaze.

Virgo.sanskrit: स्त्रीलोलो लम्बबाहुर्ललिततनुमुखश्चारुदन्ताक्षिकर्णो । विद्वानाचारधर्मी प्रियवचनयुतः सत्यशौचप्रधानः । धीरः सत्त्वानुकम्पी परविषयरतः क्षान्तिसौभाग्यभागी । कन्याप्रायप्रसूतिर्बहुसुतरहितः कन्यकायां शशाङ्के ॥
Virgo.engine_rendering: Fond of women, long-armed, of graceful body and face, with beautiful teeth, eyes and ears; learned, correct in observance, of pleasing speech, with truth and purity foremost in him; steadfast, compassionate towards living beings, drawn to the domains of others, sharing in patience and good fortune; his offspring chiefly daughters, and without many sons.

Libra.sanskrit: उन्नासो व्यायताक्षः कृशवदनतनुर्भूरिदायी वृषाय । गोभूभ्यः शौचसारो वृषसमवृषणो विक्रमज्ञः क्रियः । भक्तो देवद्विजानां बहुविभवयुतः स्त्रीजितो हीनदेहः । धान्यादानेकबुद्धिस्तुलिनि … बन्धुवर्गोपकारी ॥
Libra.engine_rendering: High-nosed, long-eyed, of lean face and body, a lavish giver; pure in the matter of cattle and land, knowing valour, active; devoted to gods and to the twice-born, endowed with much wealth, ruled by women, of slight frame; of many plans concerning grain, and a helper of his kinsfolk.

Scorpio.sanskrit: लुब्धो वृत्तोरुजङ्घः कठिनतरतनुर्नासिकः क्रूरचेष्टः । चोरो बाल्ये रुगार्तो हतचिबुकनखश्चारुनेत्रः समृद्धः । कर्मायुक्तः प्रदक्षः परयुवतिरतो बन्धुहीनः प्रमत्तः । चण्डो राज्ञा हतस्वः पृथुजठरः स्थिराः कीटभे शीतरश्मौ ॥
Scorpio.engine_rendering: Greedy, with rounded thighs and shanks, of very hard body and nose, cruel in his acts; a thief, afflicted by disease in childhood, with damaged chin and nails yet beautiful eyes, and prosperous; occupied with work, very adept, given to other men's wives, without kinsmen, heedless; fierce, his property seized by the king, big-bellied, and firm.

Sagittarius.sanskrit: कुब्जाङ्गो वृत्तनेत्रः पृथुहृदयकटिः पीनबाहुः प्रवक्ता । दीर्घास्यो दीर्घकण्ठो जलतटवसतिः शिल्पविद् गूढगुह्यः । शूरो दृष्टोऽर्थसारो विततबहुबलः स्थूलकण्ठोष्ठवाणो । बन्धुखेदी कृतज्ञो धनुषि शशिधरे संहताङ्घ्रिः प्रगल्भः ॥
Sagittarius.engine_rendering: Of stooping body, round-eyed, broad of chest and hip, thick-armed, an orator; long-faced, long-necked, dwelling by the water's edge, skilled in craft, keeping his own counsel; brave, well regarded, his substance in wealth, of extended and abundant strength, with thick neck, lips and voice; wearying to his kinsmen, grateful, of close-set feet, and bold.
Sagittarius.output_policy_reason: socially harsh clause (bodily, caste, gender or servitude language); never rendered as a claim about a living person

Capricorn.sanskrit: गीतज्ञः शीतभीरुः पृथुतरशिराः सत्यधर्मोपसेवी । प्राज्ञः ख्यातोऽल्परोषो मनसि भयुतो निर्घृणस्त्यक्तलज्जः । चार्वक्षः क्षामदेहो गुरुयुवतिरतः सत्कविर्वृत्तज्ञो । मन्दोत्साहोऽतिबन्धुः शशिनि मकरगे दीर्घकण्ठोऽतिकर्णः ॥
Capricorn.engine_rendering: Knowing song, fearing cold, of a very broad head, a servant of truth and duty; wise, famous, little given to anger, pitiless, having cast off shame; of beautiful eyes and lean body, attached to the women of his elders, a good poet, knowing right conduct; slow in enterprise, much bound to his kinsfolk, long-necked and large-eared.

Aquarius.sanskrit: द्रोणो रूक्षदेहः पृथुकरचरणो मद्यपानप्रसक्तः । सद्द्वेष्यो धर्महीनः … स्थूलमूर्धा कुनेत्रः । रात्र्यालस्याभिभूतो विपुलमुखकटिः शिल्पविद्यासमेतो । दुःशीलो दुःखतप्तो घटमुपगते रात्रिनाथे दरिद्रः ॥
Aquarius.engine_rendering: Of rough body, broad of hand and foot, addicted to drink; hated by the good, wanting in virtue, of thick head and poor eyes; overcome by night-time sloth, of wide face and hips, possessed of craft-learning; ill-natured, scorched by sorrow, and poor.

Pisces.sanskrit: शिल्पोल्लङ्घ्याधिकार्ये हितजयनिपुणः शास्त्रविच्चारुदेहो । गेयज्ञो धर्मनिष्ठो बहुयुवतिरतः सौम्यभाग् भूपसेवी । ईषत्कोपो महल्लः सुखनिधिधनभाक् स्त्रीजितः सत्स्वभावो । वनासक्तः समुद्रे तिमियुगगते शीतगो दानशीलः ॥
Pisces.engine_rendering: In matters that go beyond mere craft, skilled at securing benefit and victory, versed in the sastras, of handsome body; knowing song, firm in duty, fond of many women, gentle, a servant of kings; slightly wrathful, of great standing, holding a treasury of comfort and wealth, ruled by women, of good nature; fond of the forest and the sea, and liberal in giving.
